versions.changelog: Fix JSONL session file parsing, add fetch timeouts, fix OpenAI classifier role handling, use JSON response mode, add LRU user eviction, add state file locking, add error logging
Initial public release with bundled hook files

- Initial release of the emotion-state skill.
- Tracks user and agent emotions as natural language phrases.
- Stores per-user emotion state across sessions in the agent state directory.
- Injects emotion trends into the system prompt for contextual awareness.
- Provides configuration options for emotion model, history, and other parameters.
